Gurugram | 0-5 years of experience | Full-Time

At InteligenAI, people take ownership beyond the boundaries of a conventional job description. We are looking for a
proactive, resourceful and versatile professional to work directly with the CEO across business research, communications,
growth initiatives and special projects.
This is a generalist role for someone who enjoys figuring things out and turning ideas into action. The responsibilities will
evolve with the company’s needs. We value people who don’t wait for every next step to be defined, but can spot what

Experience: 0–5 years in a startup, Founder’s Office, business operations, growth, marketing or a similarly
